title: Tallink seafarers’ wage warning strike
reason: The bounded ERR article read for S002 describes a wage dispute between the seafarers’ union and Tallink, a private employer, and identifies no Estonian state-policy demand. Exclude on target criterion. It reports a delayed vessel departure but gives no simultaneous attendee estimate or exact assembly site; those facts remain unknown and are not coded below threshold. S001’s body was not recovered.

title: Tallinn rally supporting Russian political prisoners at the Russian Embassy
reason: The inspected Tallinn section reports a rally at the Russian Embassy and slogans directed at Russia, including support for Russian political prisoners and demands concerning Putin and Russia. The target is a foreign state, not Estonian state policy. Meduza attributes the Tallinn account to Delfi; that report was not independently checked.
